verdict.why: In headless agent environments wrangler dev now prints Local Explorer API details.

draft.detail: wrangler dev started in a headless AI agent environment now prints the Local Explorer API URL and basic resource routes

test.error: FAIL: wrangler dev run by an AI agent without a TTY did not print the Local Explorer API URL

source.quote: When `wrangler dev` is started in a headless AI agent environment, Wrangler now prints the Local Explorer API URL and basic resource routes so agents can inspect local Workers and bindings without relying on the interactive UI.
